rewrite.words: Silver 2026-09-23, 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-25 each hold one object, and its single version is LastModified 2026-09-28 (about 11:46 UTC). The silver bucket is versioned (VersionIds are not null) with zero delete markers, so the 2026-09-28 write is the first version of each key in this history, not a rewrite of an earlier silver object. Gold: 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24 each hold one version written 2026-09-29 (10:51:56Z and 10:51:58Z); 2026-09-25 holds three versions written 2026-09-29 at 10:51:57Z, 10:53:41Z and 10:53:50Z. The gold is written after the last silver write for all three dates, by about one day. A plain LIST gives only the newest LastModified per object: it shows gold after silver for each date, but it cannot show the two earlier writes of 2026-09-25 and cannot separate a rewrite from a first write. A version LIST separates them; for silver the LIST and the version LIST agree at one version per date, so the 2026-09-28 write is a first write.
